name.ja: MG 1/100 ジム・コマンド(コロニー戦仕様)

description.ja: • 『機動戦士ガンダム 0080 ポケットの中の戦争』に登場したジム・コマンドのコロニー戦仕様をMG化。
description.en: • The colony battle version of the Jim Commando that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket" has been made into an MG.

description.ja: • 特徴的なコロニー仕様のランドセルを新規造形で再現。
description.en: • Reproduce the characteristic colony specification school bag with new modeling.

description.ja: • MG準拠の新規造形でジム・コマンドの特徴的な機体形状を再現。
description.en: • Reproduce Jim Command's characteristic aircraft shape with a new MG-compliant model.

description.ja: • 腰部のスムーズな可動や、 腕や脚など人体に近い可動域を実現し、幅広い可動領域で様々なポージングが可能。
description.en: • Smooth movement of the waist and a range of motion of the arms and legs similar to that of the human body is achieved, allowing for a wide range of motion and various poses.

description.ja: • ブルパップ・マシンガンなどの武器が付属。
description.en: • Weapons such as bullpup and machine gun are included.

accessories.ja: ブルパップ・マシンガン×1
